conviction.explanation: Consistent with the conditional bullish research verdict: rapid growth is accompanied by realized cash conversion. Leverage, customer concentration, residual-value support and absent verified valuation restrain conviction; improving short-term momentum is not a confirmed long-term reversal.

executive_summary:
Broadcom Q3 revenue grew 86% to $29.591bn and FCF reached $13.665bn, or 46% of revenue. Current cash conversion gives the operating growth case substance independent of future customer financing. The research verdict favors a conditional long-horizon growth purchase.

The strongest countercase is the combination of $59.419bn reported debt, concentrated AI customers and residual-value support in the announced financing structure. The $63bn SPV is financing, not recognized sales, and expected 2027 deliveries are not realized current revenue. Missing same-basis valuation and a price still below both major averages limit the entry case despite a positive MACD histogram.
bull_case: Realized revenue growth and $13.665bn quarterly FCF support a profitable AI deployment business; customer financing can enable deliveries.
bear_case: Valuation is unresolved, debt is material, demand is concentrated and residual-value support adds contingent exposure; a financing SPV is not recognized revenue.
key_uncertainties: Economic cost and eventual calls on residual-value support.
Customer deployment execution and delivery timing.
Quantified residual-value support exposure and complete financing terms.
Updated complete debt maturity and liquidity reconciliation.
catalysts_upcoming: Subsequent earnings showing whether revenue expansion continues with positive FCF conversion.
Disclosures quantifying residual-value support terms or actual obligations.
Actual customer deliveries and recognized revenue, rather than financing announcements alone.

correlation_notes: High beta (1.48) — price may amplify broad-market moves.
Sector: Technology — use sector-specific catalysts and risks in the thesis.
risk_assessment.max_drawdown_scenario: Historical max drawdown: 48.3% over available price history. Projected worst case (2-sigma): ~72.6% from current $351.81.

action_plan.stop_rationale: 2x ATR-14 ($11.20) below entry — invalidates the setup
action_plan.target_rationale: TP1 = nearest technical resistance (SMA-200, BB-upper, or 52w high). TP2 = 52w high / +15% stretch. Consider scaling out: sell half at TP1, let the rest ride to TP2.

research_verdict.thesis: The bull carries a conditional long-horizon growth case because expansion is accompanied by substantial realized cash conversion, not merely customer announcements. $13.665bn quarterly FCF gives the business current financial support, while financing obligations, leverage and the purchase valuation remain material constraints. Tactical stabilization is not a confirmed long-term reversal.
research_verdict.strongest_counterexample: A $59.419bn reported debt burden, concentrated AI customers and residual-value support can transmit deployment or financing problems to shareholders even while current earnings are strong.
invalidation_conditions: Two consecutive comparable quarters with free cash flow at or below zero would invalidate reliance on cash-generative growth.
Two consecutive quarters with year-over-year revenue growth at or below zero would invalidate the sustained expansion premise.
A disclosed material residual-value support payment exceeding the latest $13.665bn quarterly FCF would invalidate the assumption that present cash generation comfortably absorbs this exposure.
evidence_gaps: Quantified residual-value support exposure and complete financing terms.
Updated complete debt maturity and liquidity reconciliation.
decisive_factors: Q3 revenue rose 86% and AI semiconductor revenue rose 221%.
The $63bn SPV is not recognized current sales.
